name: Shiga Ryouji
source:
A young man who has moved into a company apartment at the head office of the rapidly growing boutique "Paris Dame".

He is a so-called "full-time househusband" who does housework for a living. Living in the company housing during the day, he quickly becomes friends with the wives of his neighbors.
